item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Esha holds two cardboard corner pieces. The diagram shows angle $R$ and angle $S$ drawn from those corners.

Which claim correctly decides which angle is larger by overlaying?

options.A: Match the vertices and align one arm of each; the free arm of angle $R$ opens farther, so angle $R$ is larger.
options.B: Leave the vertices apart on the desk and judge the openings from separate places.
options.C: Knowing that angle $R$ is larger is what creates the overlay of the cardboard corners.
options.D: Any two cardboard corner pieces must be equal angles.
